The structure of composition P₂TlO₄ crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing seven atoms and seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral P centers coordinated by four O neighbors, and octahedral Tl centers coordinated by six O neighbors, with P–O distances of 1.55–1.62 Å and Tl–O distances of 2.13–2.41 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all seven sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between P tetrahedra and Tl octahedra, and edge-sharing between Tl octahedra.
